Yellow Dal

.cook
#Indian #Dinner #30-45min #Beginner #Contains-Soy #Vegan #Gluten-Free
👥 4 servings servings 🍽️ Main Course/Dal ⏱️ Prep Time: 10 minutes 🔥 Cook Time: 40 minutes 🌍 Indian 🥗 GlutenFree, Vegan, Vegetarian 📖 https://holycowvegan.net/dal-recipe/4185 carb: none method: stovetop protein: legumes alternative_name: The Best Dal Recipe

🥘 Ingredients

Cook lentils

  • toor dal
    1 c
  • turmeric
    ½ tsp

Make the tempering or "tadka"

  • ?asafetida
    ¼ tsp
  • ?curry leaves
    2 sprigs
  • black mustard seeds
    1 tsp
  • cilantro
    2 tbsp
  • cumin seeds
    1 tsp
  • green chili peppers (cut into thin strips, deseeded for less heat)
    1-2
  • oil
    1 tbsp
  • tomatoes (finely diced)
    2 medium

Add the lentils

  • lemon juice
    ½ lemon
  • salt
    to taste

🍳 Cookware

  • pot
  • pressure
  • Instant Pot liner
  • whisk
  • saucepan
  • Dutch oven
  • karahi
  • saucepan

Cook lentils

  1. 1
    Place the toor dal with turmeric and water in a pot , pressure cooker or Instant Pot liner .
    toor dal: 1 c, turmeric: ½ tsp
  2. 📝

    See FAQs above for more on how to do this.

  3. 2
    Cook the dal until very creamy. Use a whisk to lightly beat the dal until it's creamy.

Make the tempering or "tadka"

  1. 1
    Heat the oil in a wide saucepan , Dutch oven or karahi , then add the black mustard seeds and cumin seeds and ?asafetida , if using.
    oil: 1 tbsp, black mustard seeds: 1 tsp, cumin seeds: 1 tsp, ?asafetida: ¼ tsp
  2. 📝

    Use any oil of your choice, including avocado oil, sunflower oil, grapeseed oil, peanut oil or coconut oil.

  3. 2
    As soon as the mustard seeds sputter, add the cilantro and ?curry leaves and the green chili peppers .
    cilantro: 2 tbsp, ?curry leaves: 2 sprigs, green chili peppers: 1-2 (cut into thin strips, deseeded for less heat)
  4. 📝

    Use green chili peppers like jalapeno or serrano.

  5. 3
    Sauté the cilantro and curry leaves for ⏱️ 1 minute , then stir in the tomatoes . Cook the tomatoes until they have expressed most of their juices and are very soft.
    tomatoes: 2 medium (finely diced)

Add the lentils

  1. 1
    Add the cooked dal to the saucepan and mix well. Add water to thin out the lentils - I add about a cup. Bring the dal to a boil, lower heat to simmer, cover and cook for ⏱️ 5 minutes . This gives the flavors a chance to meld.
  2. 2
    Turn off the heat, then add in the lemon juice and salt and garnish with more cilantro before serving.
    lemon juice: ½ lemon, salt: to taste
